payload.title: Visualizing multivariate, spatio-temporal information in the Cloud with widgets
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates how to visualize the relationship between volcanic activity and climate changes over the Common Era using interactive widgets. It focuses on plotting Hovmuller diagrams and global average time series of stratospheric aerosol optical depth (SAOD) using data from the eVolv2k dataset. The notebook also integrates data from the Last Millennium Reanalysis Project to explore climate responses to volcanic events. The final output is a dashboard that allows users to interactively explore these visualizations.
